card.name: "Before" after a time interval
card.fires_on: The word "before" right after an amount of time such as "at least 2 hours" or "30 minutes" in dose-spacing instructions, usually followed by "or ... after" or "meals".

modes.label: Spacing around another drug
modes.description: "Before" follows "at least N hours" in instructions to separate doses from interacting products.
